regions.title: Neck
regions.intro: Neck pain is usually tied to posture (especially looking down at phones/laptops), stress-related muscle tension, or sleeping in an awkward position.
causes: "Tech neck" from looking down at screens for long periods
Poor desk/monitor setup or slouched sitting posture
Stress, which tends to concentrate tension in the neck and upper traps

videos.title: 10 Best Neck Pain Exercises/Stretches Ever Created
The 5 Highest Rated Stretches For Neck Pain, Fast Relief!

regions.title: Shoulders
regions.intro: Shoulder pain often comes from overhead activity, poor posture pulling the shoulders forward, or impingement from repetitive motion.
causes: Overuse from throwing, lifting, or overhead sports
Sleeping on the same side every night

videos.title: 5 Exercises For Shoulder Pain Relief (No More Impingement!)
Sleeper Shoulder Stretch - Physical Therapy Exercises

regions.title: Upper Back
regions.intro: Upper back (thoracic spine) stiffness is extremely common with desk work — it's the area that gets stuck in a hunched position when we sit for hours.
causes: Weak mid-back muscles relative to a tight chest
Carrying a heavy bag on one shoulder

videos.title: 3 Simple Stretches Upper to Mid-Back (Thoracic Spine)
Fix Your Upper Back Pain! [Increase Your Thoracic Mobility]

regions.title: Lower Back
regions.intro: Lower back pain is one of the most common complaints and is frequently linked to tight hip flexors/hamstrings, weak core muscles, or too much sitting.
causes: Prolonged sitting compressing the lumbar spine
Tight hip flexors or hamstrings pulling on the pelvis
Bending or lifting with poor form

videos.title: WORKS FAST! Best Stretches For Low Back Pain - From a Physical Therapist
TEN Best Stretches For Lower Back Pain And Stiffness

regions.title: Chest
regions.intro: Tight chest (pec) muscles are the flip side of upper-back stiffness — desk posture shortens the chest while it lengthens and weakens the upper back.
causes: Heavy pressing exercise without balancing pulling exercise

videos.title: Chest Stretch for Tight or Sore Muscles: Pectoralis Major and Minor
Tight Chest Muscles? 5 Exercises to Loosen Your Pecs & Improve Posture

regions.title: Hips
regions.intro: Tight hip flexors are extremely common in people who sit a lot — the hip flexors shorten while sitting and don't get stretched back out.
causes: Prolonged sitting shortening the hip flexors
Running or cycling without balancing mobility work
Weak glutes forcing the hip flexors to overwork

videos.title: The Best Hip Flexor Stretch | Taught by a Physical Therapist
Best Exercises For Hip Flexor Pain - From a Physical Therapist

regions.title: Glutes
regions.intro: Glute tightness or weakness is a common contributor to hip and lower back pain, often made worse by long periods of sitting.
causes: Piriformis tightness irritating the sciatic nerve
Overuse from running, squatting, or lifting

videos.title: Glute Stretches to Release Tension - 5 Exercises (10 Min Physio Guide)
3 Glute Stretches (Release Tightness)

regions.title: Hamstrings (Back of Thigh)
regions.intro: Tight hamstrings are common with prolonged sitting and running, and can contribute to lower back discomfort.
causes: Running or sprinting without adequate warm-up/cool-down
Previous hamstring strain that healed short and tight

videos.title: A Physical Therapist's Favorite Hamstring Stretches
Fix Your Hamstrings! Stretches & Exercises For Tight, Painful Hamstrings

regions.title: Quads (Front of Thigh)
regions.intro: Tight quads are common after running, cycling, or squatting, and can pull on the kneecap, contributing to knee discomfort.
causes: Muscle imbalance relative to the hamstrings

videos.title: How to Do a Quad Stretch: A Guide from Physical Therapists
Science Says This Is the BEST Quad Strengthening Exercise

regions.title: Knees
regions.intro: Knee pain is often driven by tightness or weakness in the surrounding muscles (quads, hamstrings, calves) rather than the knee joint itself.
causes: Tight quads, hamstrings, or calves pulling on the knee
Weak quads/glutes causing poor knee tracking
Overuse from running or jumping sports

videos.title: 10 Best Knee Pain Exercises Ever Created (Stretches & Strengthening)
BEST Knee Strengthening Exercises for Beginners [Fix Knee Pain]

regions.title: Calves & Lower Leg
regions.intro: Tight calves are common with running, wearing heels, or standing/walking a lot, and can affect ankle mobility.
causes: Running, walking, or standing a lot

videos.title: STOP Calf Pain | Best Stretches For Calves
The Correct Way to Stretch Your Calf | Physical Therapist

regions.title: Ankles & Feet
regions.intro: Limited ankle mobility can affect squatting, walking, and running mechanics, and often follows an old sprain that never fully rehabbed.
causes: Standing/walking a lot on hard surfaces

videos.title: Improve Ankle Mobility! Exercises To Unlock A Tight, Stiff Ankle
How to Improve Ankle Joint Mobility (4 Directions of Movement)

regions.title: Elbows
regions.intro: Elbow pain (often "tennis elbow" or "golfer's elbow") usually comes from repetitive gripping or wrist motion, not the elbow joint itself.
causes: Sudden increase in activity involving the forearm

videos.title: TOP 6 Elbow Pain Relief Exercises & Stretches (Tennis Elbow)
10 Best Tennis Elbow Exercises & Stretches

regions.title: Wrists & Forearms
regions.intro: Wrist and forearm tightness is common with typing, mousing, and phone use, and can contribute to elbow pain over time.

videos.title: BEST Wrist Forearm Stretches to Release Tightness and Pain
Wrist and Forearm Stretches for Stiffness Follow Along

regions.title: Abs (Rectus Abdominis)
regions.intro: The rectus abdominis runs down the front of the abdomen and can get tight from heavy ab training or achy from long stretches of sitting hunched forward.
causes: Poor core endurance relative to other muscle groups

videos.title: Rectus Abdominis Stretch
Ab Stretches

regions.title: Obliques
regions.intro: The obliques run along the sides of the abdomen and handle twisting and side-bending — they're prone to strain from sudden rotational movement.
causes: A sudden or awkward twisting movement

videos.title: Internal & External Oblique Muscle Stretch
Abs and Oblique Stretch (Tight Abs Fix!)

regions.title: Serratus Anterior
regions.intro: This "fingers on the ribs" muscle under the armpit stabilizes the shoulder blade — when it's weak or tight, overhead movement and posture both suffer.
causes: Weak shoulder stabilizers relative to bigger pressing muscles

videos.title: How to Stretch the Serratus Anterior
8 Best Exercises for Serratus Anterior (Shoulder and Scapular Strength)

regions.title: Biceps
regions.intro: The biceps run along the front of the upper arm and cross both the elbow and shoulder, so tightness here can show up as elbow or shoulder discomfort too.
causes: Carrying heavy bags with a bent elbow
Overuse from climbing, throwing, or rowing sports

videos.title: The Best Stretch for Tight Biceps
Biceps Tendonitis Stretches & Exercises

regions.title: Trapezius
regions.intro: The trapezius spans the back of the neck and upper back, and is where most people physically feel stress — it's usually the first thing to tense up.
causes: Stress, which concentrates tension in the upper traps
Carrying a heavy bag or backpack on one shoulder

videos.title: Upper Trapezius Stretch
How to Relieve Upper Trapezius Pain FAST (Try This First!)

regions.title: Latissimus Dorsi
regions.intro: The lats are the broad muscles spanning the sides of the mid-back — tightness here can limit overhead reach and contribute to shoulder impingement.

videos.title: How to Stretch the Latissimus Dorsi (Tight Lats) - Best 3 Lat Stretches
Lat Stretches & Exercises (Latissimus Dorsi)

regions.title: Adductors (Inner Thigh)
regions.intro: The adductors run along the inner thigh and pull the leg inward — they're a common site for strains ('groin pulls') in sports with quick lateral movement.
causes: Sudden lateral movement or direction changes (soccer, hockey, basketball)
Inadequate warm-up before sprinting or kicking
Muscle imbalance between adductors and abductors
Previous groin strain that healed short and tight

videos.title: Stretches & Exercises for Groin Pulls (Adductor Strain)
4 Groin Pain Exercises (Adductor Muscle Strains and Tendinopathy)

regions.title: Triceps
regions.intro: The triceps run along the back of the upper arm and straighten the elbow — overuse from pressing movements is the most common source of tightness.
causes: Leaning on elbows for long periods
Overhead throwing or serving in sports

videos.title: How to Stretch Your Triceps (and How Not To!)
